product.name: Party Printables Kit
product.description: An editable Canva card template at A6 (105 x 148 mm) — four pages, each with the background running full bleed and the ten millimetre type area already placed, so everything you write sits where the printer can actually reach: the invitation, the table number, the thank-you card and a spare. A Canva design holds one page size, so the A4 four-up layup and the 50 x 90 mm favour tag are on the printed sheets instead — sheet one draws the tiling to scale and it is a two-minute job. Plus five reference sheets: the card size and envelope chart, the print-dialog guide with the setting named for Acrobat, Chrome, macOS and Windows, the paper weight guide, the trimming guide, and the pre-print checklist (Genius Junkie)
